findings.question: error-handling
findings.note: Observation, not a finding: genesis trusts source-manifest completeness for testSha256 (as it already does for sha256). A malformed non-release source surfaces as a deferred, fail-closed provenance failure downstream rather than an error at genesis time. Acceptable and consistent with existing design; the completeness invariant is owned by check-upstream-manifest-integrity. Recorded in ADR-0111 'Honest limits' (Option 2 considered and rejected for the same reason).

verdict: PASS (full matrix observed clean; minimal correctly-placed projection restores provenance completeness; accompanying test proven mutation-sensitive; no regression, 49/49). Limitation: the consumer-side manifest-provenance gate was not run end-to-end against a live release asset in this review; downstream fail-closed behavior traced by code reading.
